# AI Man Jack

> AI Man Jack LLC (aimanjack.com) is Jack Qian's Dallas, Texas company for corporate AI training and practical AI workflow training. Jack teaches non-technical teams — sales, operations, marketing, managers — in English or Chinese, onsite in Dallas–Fort Worth or remotely. Each participant brings a task they already do and leaves with a working AI workflow (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot) plus a checklist for verifying its output. Formats: a 90-minute session, a half-day hands-on workshop (from $1,500 for up to 10 people) and a multi-week program. Evidence shown on the site: 5 community AI talks in Plano and Dallas with 50+ people each, one 37-person AI hackathon, and 10 Google reviews averaging 5.0. To plan a team workshop, book a 30-minute call at https://aimanjack.com/book/, email jack@aimanjack.com, or text TRAINING to (469) 425-4142.

Key facts:
- Company: AI Man Jack LLC, Dallas, Texas. Founder and trainer: Jack Qian. One person designs, teaches and follows up.
- Service: corporate AI training and AI workflow training for teams of roughly 5 to 60 people. Taught in English or Chinese. Onsite anywhere in Dallas–Fort Worth (Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Richardson, Frisco, McKinney, Arlington); remote on request.
- Method, five parts: choose a suitable task, give the AI useful context, move from chat to workflow, verify the output, apply data and approval guardrails. Two weeks after a session Jack checks whether the workflow was tested, was accurate enough to use, and should continue, change or stop.
- Tools: whichever the company has approved — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot. The method is tool-agnostic. No coding.
- Pricing: half-day hands-on workshops from $1,500 for up to 10 people at the client's office. 90-minute sessions and multi-week programs are quoted by team size after one 30-minute call; written quote within 24 hours.
- Proof: 5 community talks (50+ attendees each), one 37-person hackathon, 10 Google reviews at 5.0, all from workshop attendees. No client ROI figures are claimed.
- Sister site: https://realagentusecases.com/ — Jack's weekly newsletter on AI agents and workflows working professionals actually run (learn there; train with AI Man Jack).
- Profiles: https://realagentusecases.com/ · https://github.com/qianquandong · https://www.linkedin.com/in/quandong-qian-156563191/ · https://www.youtube.com/@JackBuildAI · https://x.com/JackQianAI · https://www.threads.com/@jack_qian616

## Pages

- [Home](https://aimanjack.com/): what AI Man Jack helps teams do, entry points to tools, use cases, workflows and training
- [Corporate AI training](https://aimanjack.com/ai-training/): the five-part curriculum, who it is for, formats and pricing, Google reviews, FAQ
- [Free AI tools](https://aimanjack.com/tools/): the AI Readiness Assessment — 10 questions, deterministic score across people, usage, processes, knowledge, tools, governance, leadership and measurement; no email required
- [AI use cases by team](https://aimanjack.com/use-cases/): sales, marketing, operations, leadership
- [AI workflows](https://aimanjack.com/workflows/): step-by-step workflows, each with the prompt, an illustrative example, a human review checklist and when not to use it
- [AI templates](https://aimanjack.com/templates/): copy-and-paste prompts and worksheets, including the four-question AI Use Case Discovery Worksheet
- [Resources](https://aimanjack.com/blog/): field notes on training employees to use AI and on AI workflows
- [About](https://aimanjack.com/about/): Jack Qian and AI Man Jack LLC
- [Book a 30-minute call](https://aimanjack.com/book/): choose a US Central time to plan a team workshop
- [Contact](https://aimanjack.com/contact/): book, email or text

Chinese versions of the home, training, resources, about, contact and booking pages live under https://aimanjack.com/zh/. Tools, use cases, workflows and templates are English only.
